headline: Rogers State's goals come from seven different players
dek: Rogers State have won all three of their matches, and seven different players have shared their goals; only Harkaran Sahota and Alex Laing have scored twice. Ouachita Baptist remain the other unbeaten side and have yet to concede.
displaced_by: Rogers State's third win, at Rockhurst, took their scorers to seven; the old dek's Rogers State figures were no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State alone have outscored Newman, Southern Nazarene, Northeastern State and Harding put together.

wire.line: Harding have played once and are still waiting for their first goal of the season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's match at Southwest Baptist is past its date with no result published at all, the only match this season in that state. There is no score gap: every match marked final carries a score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Every match with a published score also has a box score behind it. The collector reached the detail of each.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's draw with Delta State is still the only match this season that a programme in this conference has neither won nor lost.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tristan Miller has made twelve saves for Rogers State and been beaten twice.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fort Hays State's six goals have come from six different players.

last_match.line: Rockhurst had already beaten Newman on this ground; Rogers State leave with every match of their season won.

next_match.line: Harding's only match so far ended in a home defeat to Delta State without a goal of their own.
